items.source: The spring-boot-devtools and spring-boot-docker-compose modules are automatically excluded by default (you can control this using the excludeDevtools and excludeDockerCompose properties). In order to make that work with war packaging, the spring-boot-devtools and spring-boot-docker-compose dependencies must be set as optional or with the provided scope.
items.translation: `spring-boot-devtools` 和 `spring-boot-docker-compose` 模块默认会自动排除（您可以使用 `excludeDevtools` 和 `excludeDockerCompose` 属性来控制此行为）。为了使它们与 war` 打包方式兼容，必须将 `spring-boot-devtools` 和 `spring-boot-docker-compose` 依赖设置为 `optional` 或使用 `provided 作用域。

items.source: The <into> block claims content using nested <include> and <exclude> elements. The <application> section uses Ant-style path matching for include/exclude expressions. The <dependencies> section uses group:artifact[:version] patterns. It also provides <includeModuleDependencies /> and <excludeModuleDependencies /> elements that can be used to include or exclude local module dependencies.
items.translation:
`<into>` 块使用嵌套的 `<include>` 和 `<exclude>` 元素来声明内容。
`<application>` 部分使用 Ant 风格的路径匹配来处理包含/排除表达式。
`<dependencies>` 部分使用 `group:artifact[:version]` 模式。
它还提供了 `<includeModuleDependencies />` 和 `<excludeModuleDependencies />` 元素，可用于包含或排除本地模块依赖项。

items.source: Looking at the <dependencies> example above, we can see that the first <into> will claim all module dependencies for the application.layer. The next <into> will claim all SNAPSHOT dependencies for the snapshot-dependencies layer. The final <into> will claim anything left (in this case, any dependency that is not a SNAPSHOT) for the dependencies layer.
items.translation: 查看上面的 `<dependencies>` 示例，我们可以看到第一个 `<into>` 将声明 `application.layer` 的所有模块依赖。下一个 `<into>` 将声明 `snapshot-dependencies` 层的所有 SNAPSHOT 依赖。最后一个 `<into>` 将声明剩余的任何内容（在这种情况下，任何不是 SNAPSHOT 的依赖）到 `dependencies` 层。

items.source: By default, both the repackage and the run goals will include any provided dependencies that are defined in the project. A Spring Boot project should consider provided dependencies as "container" dependencies that are required to run the application. Generally speaking, Spring Boot projects are not used as dependencies and are therefore unlikely to have any optional dependencies. When a project does have optional dependencies they too will be included by the repackage and run goals.
items.translation: 默认情况下，repackage 和 run 目标都会包含项目中定义的任意 provided 依赖项。Spring Boot 项目应将 provided 依赖项视为运行应用程序所需的“容器”依赖项。一般来说，Spring Boot 项目不作为依赖项使用，因此不太可能有任意 optional 依赖项。当项目确实存在可选依赖项时，repackage 和 run 目标也会包含它们。

If some of these dependencies need to be excluded, you can use one of the exclude options; see the dependency exclusion for more details.

items.source: A repackaged jar contains the application’s classes and dependencies in BOOT-INF/classes and BOOT-INF/lib respectively. Similarly, an executable war contains the application’s classes in WEB-INF/classes and dependencies in WEB-INF/lib and WEB-INF/lib-provided. For cases where a docker image needs to be built from the contents of a jar or war, it’s useful to be able to separate these directories further so that they can be written into distinct layers.
items.translation: 重打包的 jar 包分别在 BOOT-INF/classes` 和 `BOOT-INF/lib` 中包含应用程序的类和依赖项。同样，可执行的 war 包在 `WEB-INF/classes` 中包含应用程序的类，并在 `WEB-INF/lib` 和 `WEB-INF/lib-provided 中包含依赖项。对于需要从 jar 或 war 的内容构建 Docker 镜像的情况，能够进一步分离这些目录以便将它们写入不同的层是非常有用的。

items.source: Nested <into> blocks are used within <application> and <dependencies> sections to claim content for a layer. The blocks are evaluated in the order that they are defined, from top to bottom. Any content not claimed by an earlier block remains available for subsequent blocks to consider.

items.source: By default, the repackage goal replaces the original artifact with the repackaged one. That is a sane behavior for modules that represent an application but if your module is used as a dependency of another module, you need to provide a classifier for the repackaged one. The reason for that is that application classes are packaged in BOOT-INF/classes so that the dependent module cannot load a repackaged jar’s classes.
items.translation: 默认情况下，`repackage` 目标会用重新打包后的构件替换原始构件。对于代表应用程序的模块来说，这是一种合理的行为；但如果您的模块被用作另一个模块的依赖项，则需要为重新打包后的构件提供分类器。原因是应用程序类被打包在 BOOT-INF/classes 中，因此依赖模块无法加载重新打包的 jar 中的类。

items.source: Classifier to add to the repackaged archive. If not given, the main artifact will be replaced by the repackaged archive. If given, the classifier will also be used to determine the source archive to repackage: if an artifact with that classifier already exists, it will be used as source and replaced. If no such artifact exists, the main artifact will be used as source and the repackaged archive will be attached as a supplemental artifact with that classifier. Attaching the artifact allows to deploy it alongside to the original one, see the Maven documentation for more details.
items.translation: 要添加到重新打包归档中的分类器。如果未指定，主构件将被重新打包的归档替换。如果指定了该分类器，它还将用于确定要重新打包的源归档：如果已存在具有该分类器的构件，则将其用作源并替换；如果不存在这样的构件，则将使用主构件作为源，并将重新打包的归档附加为具有该分类器的补充构件。附加构件允许将其与原始构件一起部署，有关更多详细信息，请参阅 Maven 文档。

items.source: Collection of artifact definitions to exclude. The Exclude element defines mandatory groupId and artifactId components and an optional classifier component. When configured as a property, values should be comma-separated with colon-separated components: groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier
items.translation: 要排除的构件定义集合。Exclude 元素定义了必需的 groupId 和 artifactId 组件以及可选的 classifier 组件。当配置为属性时，值应以逗号分隔，组件之间以冒号分隔：groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier

items.source: Collection of artifact definitions to include. The Include element defines mandatory groupId and artifactId components and an optional classifier component. When configured as a property, values should be comma-separated with colon-separated components: groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier
items.translation: 要包含的制品定义集合。Include 元素定义了必需的 groupId 和 artifactId 组件以及可选的 classifier 组件。当配置为属性时，值应以逗号分隔，组件之间以冒号分隔：groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier

items.source: The type of archive (which corresponds to how the dependencies are laid out inside it). Possible values are JAR, WAR, ZIP, DIR, NONE. Defaults to a guess based on the archive type.
items.translation: 归档类型（对应其内部依赖的布局方式）。可能的值为 JAR`、`WAR`、`ZIP`、`DIR` 和 `NONE。默认值基于归档类型进行猜测。

items.source: The layers order is important as it determines how likely previous layers can be cached when part of the application changes. The default order is dependencies, spring-boot-loader, snapshot-dependencies, application. Content that is least likely to change should be added first, followed by layers that are more likely to change.
items.translation: 层顺序很重要，因为它决定了当应用程序的一部分发生变化时，前一层被缓存的可能性。默认顺序为 dependencies`、`spring-boot-loader`、`snapshot-dependencies` 和 `application。最不可能变化的内容应首先添加，随后是更可能变化的层。

items.source: Repackage existing JAR and WAR archives so that they can be executed from the command line using java -jar. With layout=NONE can also be used simply to package a JAR with nested dependencies (and no main class, so not executable).
items.translation: 重新打包现有的 JAR 和 WAR 归档文件，以便可以使用 java -jar` 从命令行执行。使用 `layout=NONE 也可以仅用于打包包含嵌套依赖的 JAR（且无主类，因此不可执行）。

items.source: The plugin can create executable archives (jar files and war files) that contain all of an application’s dependencies and can then be run with java -jar.
items.translation: 该插件可以创建包含应用程序所有依赖项的可执行归档文件（jar 文件和 war 文件），然后使用 java -jar 运行它们。

items.source: The name of the main class. If not specified the first compiled class found that contains a main method will be used.
items.translation: 主类的名称。如果未指定，将使用找到的第一个包含 main 方法的编译类。

items.source: When a layered jar or war is created, the spring-boot-jarmode-tools jar will be added as a dependency to your archive. With this jar on the classpath, you can launch your application in a special mode which allows the bootstrap code to run something entirely different from your application, for example, something that extracts the layers. If you wish to exclude this dependency, you can do so in the following manner:
items.translation: 当创建分层 jar 或 war 时，`spring-boot-jarmode-tools` jar 将被添加为归档的依赖项。在类路径中包含此 jar 后，您可以以特殊模式启动应用程序，该模式允许引导代码执行与您的应用程序完全不同的操作（例如，提取分层）。如果您希望排除此依赖项，可以按以下方式操作：

items.translation: 默认情况下，定义以下图层：

items.source: Exclude Spring Boot devtools from the repackaged archive.
items.translation: 从重新打包的归档中排除 Spring Boot devtools。

items.source: Exclude Spring Boot dev services from the repackaged archive.
items.translation: 从重新打包的归档中排除 Spring Boot 开发服务。

items.source: Comma separated list of groupId names to exclude (exact match).
items.translation: 要排除的 groupId 名称逗号分隔列表（精确匹配）。

items.source: Include optional dependencies.
items.translation: 包含可选依赖项。

items.source: Include system scoped dependencies.
items.translation: 包含系统范围的依赖项。

items.source: Include JAR tools.
items.translation: 包含 JAR 工具。

items.source: Layer configuration with options to disable layer creation, exclude layer tools jar, and provide a custom layers configuration file.
items.translation: 支持禁用图层创建、排除图层工具 JAR 以及提供自定义图层配置文件选项的图层配置。

items.source: The layout factory that will be used to create the executable archive if no explicit layout is set. Alternative layouts implementations can be provided by 3rd parties.
items.translation: 如果未设置显式布局，将用于创建可执行归档的布局工厂。第三方可以提供替代的布局实现。

items.source: Skip the execution.
items.translation: 跳过执行。
